We stopped quoting a yearly figure first and now lead with the monthly one,
because every prospect asked for the monthly number anyway before they would
carry on with the conversation.

This replaces the older practice of opening with the annual contract value,
which the pricing note describes as the thing that made the first call longer
than it needed to be.
